title: Rory and the Glowing Glade
verses:
The silver moon rose o'er the sleepy green glade,
While Psittaco chirped from a moss-covered crest.
The shadows stretched out in a shimmering shade,
To whisper that all of the giants should rest.

Sweet Nia flew down with a flutter of wings,
And guided the crew through the whispery trees,
Where blossoms unfolded like magical rings,
That danced in the night with a slow, gentle breeze.

Big Benny stepped forward with heavy, slow tread,
To clear out the path where the riverbanks gleam.
Then Tilly made space for a velvet-soft bed,
Right under the stars by the murmuring stream.

Brave Ricky settled his armored, tough shell,
And rested his chin on his paw with a sigh.
A quiet blanket of night-blossoms fell,
While fireflies drifted along in the sky.

Tiny Psittaco nestled right down in the leaves,
Beside green friend Rory, who yawned long and deep.
The wind hummed a song through the forest's dark eaves,
To cradle the friends as they drifted to sleep.

The valley grew still as the twilight turned dim,
And moonlight poured down in a soft silver stream.
Each dinosaur curled up with tail tucked to limb,
To rest in the light of a comforting dream.
